notes: extension: close 0.6% vs its 20-SMA, -1.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base inside the shaded box shows multiple wide, overlapping red and green bars with the stock oscillating between roughly 210 and 225 — visually loose and not the tight, quiet consolidation Bonde requires; the measured giveback of 0.42 confirms the base surrendered nearly half the prior leg. The burst bar itself is narrow (1.9% range, not the widest of the last five sessions), and the prior-breakout note records 0 of 4 working in the last 60 sessions, which is a concrete track record of failure on this name. RE fails outright and C fails outright, leaving only a thin dollar-scan admission holding this together.
claude.key_risk: BIIB is a biotech with a documented 0-for-4 recent breakout record, meaning any headline or binary event can gap the stock against the position before the stop can be honored.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of 219.05 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above the entry ceiling, as the loose base and failed RE give no cushion for a weak open.

row.summary: BIIB: +1.4% on 1.4× volume out of a base 7.5% deep. C 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
